note: Hiawatha NF campground on 190-acre Pete's Lake, about 10 mi south of Munising via H-13 and FR 2173. Spacious, private forested sites, a few overlooking the lake, on blacktop roads. Shaded day-use picnic area on the shore with a swimming beach (no lifeguard), accessible fishing pier and boat ramp; the 9-mile Bruno's Run Trail passes through the campground. --Claude
summary: rec.gov + catalog + FS page (updated 2026-10-09): base $26 -> $24-26 (FS '$24 - $26 per site'; $24 at five sites), group sites $50; no electric (confirmed); 48 sites (was 41) to 75 ft, all back-in (new); vault toilets and potable water (confirmed); season May 13 - Sept 30 (new); reservable on rec.gov (confirmed) with 23 first-come sites and a first-come opening week, 4-day cutoff, no minimum stay; senior/access 50% (now stated). Water/sewer left as derived false (catalog silent). No Hiawatha alert or order affects H-13, FR 2173 or the campground. Phone 906-387-2512 (Munising RD) left; rec.gov's facility contact is (906) 767-1111. Note trimmed of field restatements.
